summary.text: Cody York is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Merrimack 4, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, York described himself as a lifelong Granite Stater and former campaign manager who grew up in Canterbury.

paragraphs.text: York said in his Ballotpedia survey that he grew up on a dirt road in Canterbury and is 24 years old.

He said that watching people he grew up with leave town because of high costs, his grandmother struggle to find affordable housing, and voters he spoke with as a campaign manager describe their property taxes as crushing led him to run.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on September 8, 2026.

York said in the survey that his priorities include easing property tax burdens without a sales or income tax, funding public schools, raising Medicaid reimbursements for home care, and encouraging towns to expand housing options through state incentives.
He listed former state representatives Howard Moffett, George Saunderson and Frank Tupper, Merrimack County Sheriff David Croft, and sheriff candidate Peter Shephard as endorsers.
